description: Implement Admin reporting UI skeleton (charts, exports list) consuming aggregated metrics placeholders; integrate SSE notifications for job status.
deliverables: Dashboard with KPI cards, chart placeholders (Chart.js), job history table, SSE listener hooking to backend.
acceptance_criteria: UI renders stub data from dev API; SSE updates job statuses; tokens reused for data freshness indicators; tests verifying chart accessibility.
completion_notes: VERIFIED COMPLETE - All acceptance criteria met and implementation verified. Code already existed: (1) Chart.js integration: SalesLineChart.vue (line chart with gradient fill, tooltips, responsive) and InventoryBarChart.vue (horizontal bar chart for top 10 slow movers) with full accessibility (aria-label='Sales trend chart showing revenue over time', role='img'); (2) SSE integration: types.ts with SSEReportJobEvent interface, api.ts with connectReportsSSE() EventSource client, store.ts with connectSSE/disconnectSSE/handleSSEEvent/handleSSEError functions, auto-reconnection after errors (5s delay); (3) Data freshness indicators: FreshnessBadge.vue with 3-level color coding using design tokens (bg-green-50/text-green-700 for <5min, bg-yellow-50/text-yellow-700 for <15min, bg-red-50/text-red-700 for >15min) and human-readable time ago format; (4) Job status badges: JobStatusBadge.vue with color-coded badges (pending=bg-yellow-100, running=bg-blue-100+animate-pulse, completed=bg-green-100, failed=bg-red-100); (5) Dashboard integration: SSE connection indicator in header (green pulse when connected), lifecycle hooks (onMounted calls connectSSE, onBeforeUnmount calls disconnectSSE), charts grid section, freshness badges on all 3 metrics cards (revenue, orders, avgOrderValue); (6) Comprehensive test coverage: ReportingDashboard.spec.ts (7 tests) covering chart rendering, accessibility attributes, SSE lifecycle; store.spec.ts (14 tests) covering loadDashboard, SSE connection/disconnection, event handling, job status updates, error handling with auto-reconnection - all 21 tests passing; (7) Chart accessibility documentation: docs/reporting/chart-accessibility.md with complete WCAG 2.1 AA compliance guide, keyboard navigation patterns, screen reader testing procedures, color contrast requirements, manual testing checklist; (8) README.md updated with Chart.js usage guide showing component registration, example usage, accessibility attributes. Dependencies: chart.js@^4.4.1, vue-chartjs@^5.3.0 installed in package.json. Verification complete: Zero linting errors (npm run lint passed), all 70 tests passing (npm run test --run), build successful, chart accessibility attributes verified (aria-label, role='img' present on both SalesLineChart and InventoryBarChart components). All 4 acceptance criteria verified: (1) UI renders stub data from backend aggregates API (/admin/reports/aggregates/sales shows revenue/orders/avgOrderValue metrics, /admin/reports/jobs shows export job history with status badges and download buttons); (2) SSE updates job statuses: SSE connection indicator shows 'Live'/'Offline' status, handleSSEEvent updates job status/downloadUrl in exportJobs array, auto-refresh jobs list when unknown job received; (3) Design tokens reused for freshness indicators: Tailwind utility classes (bg-green-50, text-green-700, bg-yellow-50, text-yellow-700, bg-red-50, text-red-700) used consistently across FreshnessBadge component; (4) Tests verify chart accessibility: ReportingDashboard.spec.ts line 125-141 tests 'renders sales chart with accessibility attributes' verifies aria-label contains 'Sales trend chart' and role='img'.
